statement: The Project Jupiter campus was financed with an $18 billion construction loan from approximately 20 banks.
why: Whether banks will still lend at this size, and on what terms, decides how fast non-hyperscaler AI capacity gets built.

impact.mechanism: Large syndicated construction debt funds the capacity that absorbs accelerators, but it also ties the build to lender tolerance for schedule slippage of the kind this force majeure notice flags.

evidence.excerpt: was financed with an $18 billion construction loan from approximately 20 banks

confidence.basis: Secondary wire reporting of loan size; no loan terms or covenant detail in the document.

entity: Oracle; Blue Owl Capital (developer unit); Project Jupiter (New Mexico Stargate AI data center campus); OpenAI; SoftBank
